INTU.final_reason: Red team: weakened (valuation holds; owner-FCF base conservative). Price assumes ~3%/yr owner FCF growth vs base ~8% fading to 4%; base value $348 vs $271.94 (+28%). The mistake covers the GBS half only; Consumer is eroding.
kill_switch: Q2 FY2027 results (late Feb 2027): GBS like-for-like revenue growth below 10%, or the FY2027 GBS guide cut below +13%.
FY2027 tax season (Q3 FY2027 results, ~May 2027): US TurboTax units down more than 5% year over year (faster than the ~3%/yr trend).
Mailchimp sale blocked or the ~$3.3B proceeds not returned through FY2027 buybacks.
FY2027 owner FCF (FCF minus stock pay) below $4.5B.
Online paid small-business customers turn negative while GBS growth relies on price.

sizing.main_risk: Consumer erosion accelerates while GBS growth is price-led on ~4% customer growth (both exposed to AI substitutes); GBS segment margin excludes product development and support costs.
sizing.add_if: Q2 FY2027 shows GBS +13–14% with customer growth improving, and TurboTax units stabilise in the May 2027 season.

watch_signals: IRS filing-season statistics (weekly from late January 2027): self-prepared e-files vs TurboTax units
Lane B: INTU vs IGV software ETF relative strength; any open-market insider buying (divergence and behaviour-change scanners)
Lane A: real consumer spending and small-business activity (ISM services, retail sales)
HSR clearance for the Mailchimp sale; Credit Karma growth vs the +3–7% guide

SYF.final_reason: Red team: broken. The cushion only exists at a 10% cost of equity; SYF's own perpetual preferred yields 8.3–8.4% and the common has never priced below ~11% since the 2014 IPO; at 11% the probability-weighted value is −2%. A 10% card-rate cap now has presidential and incoming-majority backing, and partners can terminate early on such a change in law. Capital above the 11% CET1 target is ~$2B, not $6.2B. CLAUDE.md 6.7: broken → Watch.
back_to_survived_if: Rate-cap bills (S.381 / H.R.1944) stall after the new Congress sets its 2027 agenda
Price falls to ~1.2x TBV (~$51) while ROTCE stays above 20%
Early delinquency (30+) falls clearly below last year for 3 months

RELY.final_reason: Red team: weakened, and the cushion disappeared: with diluted shares (223.6M), 2027 at management's 16% low end and a charge for customer-funds capital, base value is $20.2–$23.5 (−7% to +8% vs $21.84). The mistake is not shown: the 2026-11-05 drop followed a slowdown in net customer adds (+144k vs +345k a year earlier). CLAUDE.md 6.6: cushion gone → Watch.
back_to_survived_if: Price below ~$17 with growth still in the high teens
Net customer adds re-accelerate above 300k a quarter
Buybacks exceed stock-based pay for two quarters

WEX.final_reason: Demoted mid-Wave 5: 93% of the 2026 guidance raise is fuel by WEX's own label; ~10.5x at 2025 fuel prices; Benefits +4.9% not ~11%; FDIC consent order on WEX Bank; activist director selling.
back_to_survived_if: Price implies <8x earnings at normal fuel prices
